ambient_events: The halo ring brightens a shade as the cloud thickens.
The water table shivers under a gust and goes flat again.
The spire beacon pulses; somewhere below, a window answers it.
The wind comes off the water clean and keeps going.
description: The crown of the obelisk: a ten-sided open deck ringed by a halo of cool white light where the shaft finally stops tapering. A glass windbreak stands as high as your shoulder and no higher, so the wind arrives filtered rather than blocked. Loungers, a marble slab of a bar, a long shallow water table that throws the halo back up at the underside of the sky. The antenna spire goes up out of the middle of it with a beacon at the tip, pulsing slow. The whole Marquee lies below in pink and cyan — the dead cinema, the precinct floodlights, the grid pretending to be a city that works — and from up here it very nearly convinces.
name: Chrome Court — The Crown
